articles.summary: Alvitre was spending 5 hours prepping payroll and 2.5 hours per certified payroll report, per project. Here's how switching from QuickBooks to purpose-built contractor payroll software changed everything.
articles.title: How She Cut Payroll & Certified Payroll Reporting Time by Over 94% (And Went To Disney World)

articles.title: How RTM Cut Prevailing Wage Payroll From 12 Hours to 7 Minutes (And What Changed)
